summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PowerBank Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its fiscal third quarter and interim financial results for the nine months ended March 31, 2026. The press release details financial highlights including a gross margin expansion to 35%, working capital improvement to $10.7 million, and a narrowed net loss of $(12.2) million from $(34.7) million in the prior year. It also discusses operational milestones such as lease agreements, project mobilizations, and executive appointments. This is a routine earnings release and does not involve a special situation transaction.
